fork_clock_exception.monotonic: Fork process START.monotonic_ns and sampler.start_ns use begin sampled on recorder entry BEFORE creating its claim. Thus fork START.monotonic_ns <= claim.monotonic_ns, opposite the ordinary claim-before-START-monotonic ordering. Claim still precedes source sampling and final process emission.
fork_clock_exception.scope: This exception is provided to prevent an invalid universal consumer ordering rule; Task2 spawn/work facts above are unchanged.
fork_clock_exception.utc: Fork claim.at is sampled at claim creation. The eventual fork process/raw at uses a later UTC sample after source verification. Fork end elapsed is its entry begin minus start entry begin. Do not apply ordinary sample alignment to guard records.

inherited_imports.additional_entries: Then inspect actual sys.modules items: every exact ModuleType with an absolute string __file__ under authorized_root must be frozen/authorized and inside an import root; append an unlisted module name/reference. Unrequested modules outside authorized_root are not automatically included. No imports are forced.
inherited_imports.authority: Allowed map is candidate.inventory entry references keyed by reference.path, updated with environment.dependencies references. Each included path must match its exact allowed byte reference. Any declared/observed path under candidate.authorized_root must also lie under at least one candidate.import_roots entry.
inherited_imports.child_relation: The derived child context copies parent required_imports unchanged. Ordinary child START/END observes its own modules at its actual phase. A spawned child is not required to have the entire parent launch list already loaded at START. Actual fork plan separately checks inherited module names/origins and hashes.
inherited_imports.ordering: Present required entries retain declared required_imports order; additional source-root entries follow actual sys.modules iteration order. Names are unique. This is not a sorted inventory or an alias-normalized list.
inherited_imports.parent_start_relation: No equality, subset or superset check compares launch.inherited_imports to parent START imports. Modules loaded after START may appear. A module no longer present and not required at end may be absent. A consumer must not impose unconditional array equality or universal START inclusion as a claimed current producer invariant.
inherited_imports.required_entries: Each parent_context.required_imports entry has exact {name,reference,phases}; unique names; phases is nonempty unique subset of {start,end}. At launch the selected phase is end. If actual sys.modules[name] is absent/None, end-required entries refuse and non-end-required entries may be omitted. A present entry must be exact ModuleType with string __file__ whose actual file reference equals the declaration. Present entries are included even if their phases list does not include end.
inherited_imports.sampling_order: Called before the fresh launch source witness. Returned list is assigned directly to launch.inherited_imports. Fork preparation later performs its own _imports(...,end) for the opaque prepared plan. Final module_names_sha256 is sampled after source/preparation; do not describe inherited_imports as a new simultaneous post-source import sample.

launch_source.clock_note: Monotonic causal order is actual source execution/launch ordering. UTC observations are separately sampled and can be compared as recorded; wall-clock nondecrease is not established by merely calling _utc. Do not synthesize a monotonic source time or assert UTC/monotonic numerical comparability.
launch_source.currently_checked_on_owner_load: _owner_info validates parsed source-witness, same actual parent identity, exact candidate/source-freeze refs, and source.at<=launch.at. It also checks launch environment against parent lineage and launch.parent_argv==parent START.argv.
launch_source.emission_order: Successful parent START emission -> active actual parent registry -> import sample -> fresh launch source query/witness emission -> optional fork preparation -> launch.monotonic_ns -> launch.at -> exclusive owner-launch emission -> actual child launch. The source-witness schema has UTC at only, no source monotonic timestamp.
launch_source.exact_reference_bindings: launch.source_witness is the exact returned ref. Source witness candidate==spec.candidate, source_freeze==spec.source_freeze, process_identity==launch.parent_identity==actual parent START.identity; head/tree/ordered inventory follow the same candidate/grant checks.
launch_source.filename: Exact fresh exclusive job.output/source-launch-{instance_id}.json produced by prepare_owner_launch. It is not the parent START process source-{parent_process_id}-start.json.
launch_source.not_explicitly_checked_on_owner_load: _owner_info does not separately enforce source-launch filename, ref inequality from parent START.source_witness, or a source.at>=parent START.at bound. The exact fresh filename and new witness are emitted by prepare_owner_launch; do not conflate this emission behavior with an existing rejection predicate.
launch_source.observation: The actual launcher calls _source with its actual sampled identity. It validates exact grant/freeze/candidate/ordered-input authority and intervals, hashes candidate inputs, acquires/releases the recorder index lock, performs actual read-only Git HEAD/index checks, samples observed_at=_utc() after the checks, and exclusively emits a P0 source-witness with that observed_at and its own identity.
launch_source.process_source_distinction: Ordinary record_process samples process.monotonic_ns/at before its own _source query; process.source_witness.at can therefore be later than process.at. This differs from launch.source_witness.at preceding launch.at and must not be reversed by one shared rule.

ordinary_owner_claim.bindings: schema='bac-hardware-owner-claim-v1'; launch==context.lifecycle[0]; identity==actual emitter identity used in its process record; role_id==context.role_id.
ordinary_owner_claim.causal_order: record_process validates authority/environment and actual parent, then calls _claim. START claim samples at=_utc() FIRST and monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns() SECOND, exclusively writes/flushes/hashes the claim, and returns. Only THEN record_process samples process START monotonic_ns, followed by process START at. Imports/Torch facts/source query/raw/process writes follow.
ordinary_owner_claim.checked_vs_emitted: The creation order is source-observed behavior. Current _claim does not independently validate a numeric claim-time relation at END; a consumer must not mistake a relation inferred from this code path for an explicit P3 predicate.
ordinary_owner_claim.controller_worker: Controller/worker paths have empty owner_claim. A worker has its own worker lifecycle; inherited worker environment keys do not turn an owner child into a worker.
ordinary_owner_claim.end_binding: _claim END rehashes the named claim, checks exact keys/schema/identity/launch/role, loads the actual same-process START and its raw observation, and requires START raw.owner_claim==[same claim ref]. It returns that same ref without rewriting or resampling claim clocks. record_process also checks END/START actual identity/spec/role/parent/replacement and nondecreasing process monotonic time.
ordinary_owner_claim.filename: Exclusive job.output/owner-claim-{instance_id}.json; same exact reference is carried in raw.owner_claim at START and END.
ordinary_owner_claim.monotonic_relation: For a successful ordinary spawn/work START on the same host/boot clock domain: launch.monotonic_ns <= claim.monotonic_ns <= process START.monotonic_ns. The claim is not allowed to be created by the parent. Do not require equal timestamps.
ordinary_owner_claim.utc_relation: Sampling calls place claim.at before process START.at and launch.at before both, but UTC can jump. No explicit claim<=START timestamp comparison is coded in _claim; independent current consumer chronology checks must use observed values and its accepted clock contract, not a guessed UTC-to-monotonic conversion.

role_and_contract.consumer_decision: Enforcing a strict-kind-only selected owner contract may be required by independent strict semantics, but it must be attributed to the accepted consumer/root contract rather than invented as an existing P3 check. This supplier authorizes no producer or P0 change.

current_job_level_kind_requirements.fork-guard: P0 job must contain a fork-three-trials obligation.
current_job_level_kind_requirements.spawn-child: P0 job must contain at least one strict-child-core OR strict-child-producer obligation.
current_job_level_kind_requirements.work-child: P0 job must contain at least one strict-child-core OR strict-child-producer obligation.

role_and_contract.full_role_equality: Find exactly one job.roles entry with id==child_role_id. Require that entire parsed role dictionary is equal to an element of parsed contract.roles, not a field subset. P0 validates both role shapes/types; contract.roles IDs are unique.
role_and_contract.important_enforcement_boundary: These are JOB-LEVEL presence checks in P0, not a P3 selected-owner-contract kind restriction. Current P3 _contract has no additional role->allowed-kind table. If some other selected obligation kind references a matching valid case-contract with the full child role and selected case, _contract itself does not reject solely because of that kind. Do not claim the current producer verifies a stronger selected-kind relation.
role_and_contract.role_exclusions: Selected role.role cannot be controller or worker. prepare_owner_launch requires start_method in {spawn,fork} and (role.role==fork-guard) iff (start_method==fork). It does not independently narrow nonfork owner roles to only spawn-child/work-child.
role_and_contract.selected_obligation: Exactly one job.obligations entry must simultaneously have contract==the supplied exact owner_contract reference and kind==parsed case-contract.obligation_kind. case_id must occur in that selected obligation.required_cases, contract.required_cases, and job.required_collected_ids.

scope: Read-only extraction from already-owned P3/P0 bodies and existing metadata. No P2 body read, module import/test/runtime, source edit, APP/Git/index mutation, checkout/branch/worktree operation.
status: Exact current producer facts only; no code/contract expansion or qualification claim
